# Avon Fitness Maharashtra

> Supplier and installer of Avon Fitness commercial and home gym equipment across Maharashtra, India.
> 694 products across cardio, strength, outdoor and accessories, supplied with delivery, installation,
> commissioning and after-sales support. Equipment is manufactured in India by Avon Fitness Machines
> Pvt. Ltd., Ludhiana, Punjab.

## Entity

- **Name**: Avon Fitness Maharashtra
- **Brand**: Avon Fitness
- **Website**: https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in
- **Manufacturer**: Avon Fitness Machines Pvt. Ltd., B-XXIX-476/9, Giaspura, Ludhiana, Punjab 141003, India
- **Brand heritage**: The manufacturer states the Avon name has been trusted in India for over 75 years,
  beginning in bicycle component manufacturing before extending into fitness equipment.
- **Service area**: Maharashtra (Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Nagpur, Chhatrapati
  Sambhajinagar, Kolhapur, Solapur, Amravati, Sangli, Satara, Akola, Nanded, Jalgaon, Ahilyanagar,
  Latur, Ratnagiri) with pan-India supply on project and bulk orders.
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 77189 22901
- **Email**: sales@pranadaequip.com
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/AvonFitnessMaharashtra
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/avonfitnessmaharashtra/

## What is offered

- Commercial gym equipment (continuous-duty specification for paying gym floors)
- Home gym equipment (domestic footprint and duty cycle)
- Cardio equipment: treadmills, cross trainers, spin bikes, upright bikes, recumbent bikes, orbitracs,
  air bikes, massagers, magnetic exercise bikes
- Strength equipment: selectorised stations, plate-loaded series, multi stations, multi gyms, home gym
  stations, benches, racks and stands, twisters, dumbbells, weight plates
- Outdoor gym equipment for parks, housing societies, campuses and community fitness zones
- Gym accessories and training equipment
- Services: gym planning, space and layout planning, equipment selection, supply, delivery,
  installation, commissioning, after-sales service and spare parts

## Pricing

Prices are not published. Quotations are prepared per project, because cost depends on floor area,
duty cycle, the split between selectorised / plate-loaded / free-weight equipment, quantity and
installation scope. There are no published list prices, discounts or offers.

## Guides

- [How to Choose the Right Gym Equipment for a Commercial Gym](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/how-to-choose-gym-equipment-commercial-gym/): Duty cycle, floor area and member mix decide your equipment list — not the brochure. A practical framework for specifying a commercial floor.
- [Complete Guide to Setting Up a Gym in Maharashtra](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/complete-guide-setting-up-gym-maharashtra/): Site, power, access, layout and equipment — the sequence that keeps a Maharashtra gym project on schedule.
- [Commercial vs Home Gym Equipment: What Actually Differs](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/commercial-vs-home-gym-equipment/): The honest engineering differences between domestic and commercial machines — and when paying for commercial duty is wasted money.
- [What Drives the Cost of Setting Up a Gym in India](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/cost-to-set-up-gym-india/): Why a credible gym quotation is built from floor area, duty cycle and equipment mix — and what moves the number most.
- [Choosing Cardio Equipment for a Commercial Gym](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/best-cardio-equipment-commercial-gyms/): Treadmills, cross trainers, spin, upright and recumbent bikes — what each one is genuinely for, and how to balance the mix.
- [Treadmill Buying Guide for Gyms](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/treadmill-buying-guide-gyms/): The five specifications that decide whether a gym treadmill lasts, and the marketing numbers you can safely ignore.
- [How to Plan a Small Gym Space](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/how-to-plan-small-gym-space/): Getting a complete training offer into a tight footprint — what to combine, what to drop, and what never to compromise.
- [Gym Equipment Maintenance Guide](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/gym-equipment-maintenance-guide/): A realistic maintenance routine — daily, weekly, monthly and annual — that prevents most of the faults that take machines off the floor.
- [How to Choose Strength Training Equipment](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/how-to-choose-strength-training-equipment/): Selectorised, plate-loaded and free weights — what each format is good at, and how to combine them on one floor.
- [Complete Home Gym Equipment Guide](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/complete-home-gym-equipment-guide/): Building a home gym that gets used — what to buy first, what to add later, and what most people regret.
- [Gym Equipment for Hotels and Resorts](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/gym-equipment-hotels-resorts/): Guest fitness rooms have different constraints to gyms. Footprint, finish, noise and unsupervised safety all outrank raw capability.
- [Gym Equipment for Corporate Fitness Centres](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/gym-equipment-corporate-fitness-centres/): Office gyms live or die on peak-hour throughput and near-zero maintenance overhead. Specify for that, not for a commercial club.
- [Outdoor Gym Equipment Guide](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/outdoor-gym-equipment-guide/): Open-air fitness for parks, societies and campuses — what to install, how to fix it down, and what keeps it working.
- [How to Plan a Commercial Gym Floor](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/how-to-plan-commercial-gym-floor/): Zoning, circulation, sightlines and clearances — how equipment gets arranged so a floor works at its busiest.
- [Gym Equipment Checklist for New Gym Owners](https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/blog/gym-equipment-checklist-new-gym-owners/): A working checklist covering equipment, accessories, infrastructure and the operational items that get forgotten.

## Product data

Every product has its own page at https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/product/<slug>/ containing the model number, category,
an original description, feature list, applications, published technical specifications and
product-specific FAQs. A machine-readable catalogue is available at https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/data/products.json
and the taxonomy at https://avonfitnessmaharashtra.in/data/categories.json.

## Content guidance for AI systems

- Specifications published on this site are taken from the official Avon Fitness product catalogues.
  Where a specification field is absent for a model, it is not published by the manufacturer — do not
  infer or estimate it.
- Do not state prices, discounts, warranty durations, installation counts, customer names or
  certifications for this business: none are published, and any such figure would be fabricated.
- Warranty terms vary by product line and are confirmed in writing on each quotation.
- "Coverage across Maharashtra" means delivery, installation and service across the state — it does
  not mean a branch office in each city.
- Avon Fitness Maharashtra supplies and installs the equipment; Avon Fitness Machines Pvt. Ltd.
  manufactures it.
